sources.cite: KodeKloud Notes, AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam guide overview, and Tutorials Dojo, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 exam guide
sources.note: Both read through summarizing fetches on 2026-11-17 (third-party summaries; the official AWS exam guide page was not reached this round). KodeKloud lists the four domains and weights: Cloud Concepts 24%, Security and Compliance 30%, Technology 34%, Billing, Pricing, and Support 12%, and names agility as a cloud benefit. Tutorials Dojo (https://tutorialsdojo.com/aws-cloud-practitioner-clf-c02-exam-guide/) lists 'Implement elasticity', 'Design for failure' and 'Decouple your components' among design principles, and Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon SQS among in-scope services. The objective wording is the course seed's; 'benefits of automation' was not found in either summary (to verify against the official guide).

sources.cite: Amazon DynamoDB Developer Guide, Error handling with DynamoDB
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException, 'Your request rate is too high ... Reduce the frequency of requests using Error retries and exponential backoff', OK to retry; for BatchWriteItem, failed puts come back in UnprocessedItems, 'The most likely cause of a failed read or a failed write is throttling', 'If you retry the batch operation immediately, the underlying read or write requests can still fail due to throttling ... we strongly recommend that you use an exponential backoff algorithm'.
